title: Mixed versions play, and an older Octave keeps working
description: Serves "Nothing breaks the viewers' evening."; "Their app keeps working.". Split from JS-079.
acceptanceCriteria: A worker of the previous version and one of this version serve the same stream, in a real-process test, without a spec hash disagreement breaking playback (or the job is refused by the older one)

With a stream replica of the previous decision version registered and an api replica of the new one, the api replica makes only plans the old replica reads and would not refuse (a real-process test), and docs/running.md no longer requires an order between api and stream

A worker of the previous release is never counted as a partner for a shared play unless it has said it can help: during a rolling upgrade no play is admitted as shared and then left without a helper, in a real-process test.

An Octave release built against an earlier contract keeps working against this server: the previous contract's check passes, allowing only what a version may add (fields, reasons, actions, messages) and nothing else.
The tables JS-194 listed are removed.
Its baseline is the camelCase contract of JS-216.
notes: Amended 2026-11-27 by D-20261127-camelcase-contract, decided by the product owner: criterion 6 added.
